title: Readable behavior results
responsibility: Groups recorded behavior results by scenario and state without strengthening the host’s conclusion.

inputs.name: entityBehavior.behavior
inputs.description: Host-derived behavior comparison, rows, scenario statuses and uncertainty explanation.

inputs.name: behaviorDuration.record
inputs.description: Verification record to inspect, or null.

inputs.name: behaviorDuration.scenarios
inputs.description: Scenario identifiers whose end-to-end job durations should be summed.

outputs.name: entityBehavior
outputs.description: Grouped before/after result cells, label and reasons. A current result passes only when something was recorded, every shown group passed and all scenario after-statuses passed. Missing results and unknown or byte-only differences remain uncertain.

outputs.name: behaviorDuration
outputs.description: Sum of durations for end-to-end jobs named with one of the scenario identifiers followed by a colon, rendered in milliseconds; null when no such jobs exist.
